mandatory_gate: AWS self-tests before credentials and acquisition
reviewed_controls: Current endpoints and per-run current vintage
Fresh provider quota minus active historical commitments and 100000-credit floor
Conditional S3 active lease, ETag takeover and ETag release
Two-request-per-second pacing, queued cancellation on provider denial
Empty response versus nonempty outcome coverage
Distinct capture, event, quote time and no feature approval
Single unique ZIP and current run report prefix
future_scope_note: Football current-season selection is correct for October 2026; a collector operating in January-June should explicitly account for preceding fall season.
